title: REQ · Tick returns an Open failure and still closes another due round
summary: A failing Controller.Open does not stop the rest of the pass and is reported by Tick
description: Context: Tick appends errors to a slice and returns errors.Join(errs...) after the loop. Desired behavior: an Open error is wrapped and returned while Close for another due round still runs. Expected result: errors.Is(err, openErr) is true and both calls are recorded. Why: one failing round must not block another round from closing.
acceptance_criteria: Given Open returns an error for a due SCHEDULED round, when Tick runs, then the returned error satisfies errors.Is with that error
Given an expired OPEN round listed after the failing round, when Tick runs, then Close is still called for it and calls are open then close in order

in_scope: Error collection and joining in Tick
preserve: Error wrapping with %w in the open and close messages

definition_of_done: Error behavior is confirmed in scheduler.go and covered by a test
